name: us3-gitignore-effect
description: US3 (FR-019, quickstart scenario 7): the config ceremony's gitignore effect creates the coverage for .specify/jira/personal.yml (alongside config.local.yml and .env) on the first run; a second run in the same workdir reports every effect unchanged and `git check-ignore .specify/jira/personal.yml` exits 0 (asserted in the conformance bats suite). Byte-identical across ports.
